entities.summary: Anders Bodelsen was a Danish writer primarily associated with the 1960 new-realism wave in Danish literature, along with Christian Kampmann and Henrik Stangerup. Bodelsen preferred the social-realistic style of writing, often thrillers about middle-class people who face the consequences of materialism, which often clashes with their human values. His thrillers also experiment with ordinary persons tempted by e.g. theft and border-morale issues. Anders Bodelsen was a authors & novelists from Frederiksberg (1937-02-11, Frederiksberg–2021-10-17). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a prominent figure in the Danish new-realism wave, Anders Bodelsen's works explored themes of materialism and human values among middle-class characters, contributing to a regional literary movement that influenced Danish literature from the 1960s onwards.
